mapper.select: SELECT bd.id AS bed_id, bd.bed_no AS bed_no, bd.status AS status, a.id AS apply_id, a.apply_no AS apply_no, a.employee_name AS employee_name, a.check_in_date AS occupied_check_in, a.check_out_date AS occupied_check_out FROM dorm_bed bd LEFT JOIN stay_apply a ON a.bed_id = bd.id AND a.status IN ('APPROVED', 'CHECKED_IN') WHERE bd.room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY bd.bed_no

SELECT r.region_id AS regionId, rg.name AS regionName, COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS roomCount,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.status = #{S_OPEN} THEN r.id END) AS openRoomCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.status = #{S_CLOSED} THEN r.id END) AS closedRoomCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.status = #{S_MAINTENANCE} THEN r.id END) AS maintenanceRoomCount, COUNT(bd.id) AS bedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN bd.status = #{S_IDLE} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS idleBedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN bd.status = #{S_OCCUPIED} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS occupiedBedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN bd.status = #{S_DISABLED} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS disabledBedCount FROM dorm_room r JOIN region rg ON rg.id = r.region_id LEFT JOIN dorm_bed bd ON bd.room_id = r.id WHERE (#{regionId} IS NULL OR r.region_id = #{regionId}) GROUP BY r.region_id, rg.name ORDER BY r.region_id

SELECT r.building_id AS buildingId, COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS roomCount, COUNT(bd.id) AS bedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN bd.status = #{S_IDLE} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS idleBedCount FROM dorm_room r LEFT JOIN dorm_bed bd ON bd.room_id = r.id WHERE (#{regionId} IS NULL OR r.region_id = #{regionId}) GROUP BY r.building_id
